summary: Merchant UI displaying blank screen post-login
description: A Merchant is unable to e-sign the agreement as they are encountering a login error when trying to access the Customer UI, leading to a delay in the onboarding process.
resolution: Developers identified a bug in the linking functionality and released a hotfix. Sales Agent successfully added the new location to the existing merchant ID.
